Window functions (AVG OVER, COUNT OVER, LAG OVER, RANK, PERCENT_RANK, MIN OVER, MAX OVER) are syntactically identical between SQL Server and PostgreSQL
CTEs (WITH clauses) are syntactically identical between SQL Server and PostgreSQL
CASE expressions and ROUND functions are syntactically identical
Parameter syntax (@param) is compatible with Npgsql for PostgreSQL
Transaction management has been successfully migrated to use NpgsqlTransaction

Application successfully compiles with Npgsql 8.0.5 and PostgreSQL-formatted connection strings
